notes.title: Patch 0.4.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Overhauled enemy pathfinding, such that they are able to navigate tighter areas while taking a more direct route. These changes should greatly reduce the chances of enemies getting stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Rebalanced projectiles such that a base amount of damage is always dealt
[*] Added messages to the loading screen
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze and required a restart
[*] Other miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

The development team is currently working on a complete overhaul of AI pathfinding that will fix a number of AI related bugs and should give the player a better experience overall.
